title: Marriage
summary: Marriage is a legally and socially recognised partnership. Long-term satisfaction is linked to friendship, communication, shared responsibilities, respect and continued affection.
answer_guidance: Be warm, practical and neutral rather than preachy. Explain the idea, then offer one or two concrete suggestions if useful. Don't judge the user's partner from limited information.
